bio.text: Warren Davidson serves in the U.S. House of Representatives, where the congressman is Chairman of the National Security & Illicit Finance subcommittee of the House Financial Services Committee.

Born and raised in Ohio, Davidson enlisted in the Army and later earned an appointment to West Point, then served as an infantry officer in the Old Guard, the 75th Ranger Regiment and the 101st Airborne Division.
Davidson earned an MBA from the University of Notre Dame and spent 15 years starting, acquiring and growing manufacturing companies in Ohio.
